messages:
kevin: Quick design thread  - propose combining small routing/quota columns into a single envelope_meta jsonb on analytics.events_envelope. Less churn when we add fields.
anjali: Why not add new columns as we go?
kevin: We do that now and every new field triggers DDL and deploy coordination. Jsonb gives flexibility + one GIN index for ad-hoc keys.
zach: Concern: dashboards use route_id and quota_profile_id heavily. jsonb lookups could regress p99 unless indexed correctly.
olivia: We can keep lightweight btree indexes on envelope_meta->>key for the top filters (route_id, quota_profile_id). Also use jsonb_path_ops GIN for wide queries.
maria: Rollout idea: dual-write ingest, read-adapter in front of console, backfill in chunks. Feature flag for console to flip new vs legacy query shape.
kevin: Planned steps:
- add envelope_meta jsonb NULL + GIN index
- enable ingest dual-write (flagged) for 2 weeks
- deploy read-adapter that maps legacy column names to envelope_meta for console/API
- run async backfill tenant-by-tenant; verify hashes and counts
- cutover and drop legacy cols after safety window

SQL snippet:
```sql
ALTER TABLE analytics.events_envelope ADD COLUMN envelope_meta jsonb NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_events_envelope_meta_gin ON analytics.events_envelope USING gin (envelope_meta jsonb_path_ops);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_envelope_meta_route ON analytics.events_envelope ((envelope_meta->>'route_id'));
```
anjali: Backfill perf? how to avoid hot partitions?
zach: Backfill in tenant-time windows, small chunks. Monitor per-tenant write amplification and queue length.
olivia: Observability: capture per-route p99 before/after for first 48h, plus missing_meta_ratio during backfill. Alert on >2% drift or p99 +20%.
maria: UX: console feature flag to revert query shape per-route so we can A/B the new adapter. Also document the new envelope_meta key names in schema-stencil.
kevin: Ownership: kevin (migration + ingest dual-write), olivia (read-adapter + docs), zach (metrics + alerts), anjali (console rollout + gating). I'll open RFC + PR with checklist and MIGRATE-ANALYTICS tag.
deploy-bot: scheduled: dual-write feature-flag rollout -> dev -> staging -> canary (20%) on Thu 09:00 PT.
kevin: Thanks, will follow up with PR link and testing plan. :thumbsup:
